heroLead: Browse Weidian listings, check available QC photos, and shop through Hipobuy.
searchPlaceholder: T-shirt, item ID or product link
imageLead: Compare a reference image against the saved Findspreadsheet image index. Your file stays on your device.
qcLead: Look up available historical warehouse photos by Weidian item ID or product link.
guideLead: Follow a product from the spreadsheet to Hipobuy, then through warehouse inspection and international shipping.
stepFindBody: Search this spreadsheet by name or paste a Weidian item ID. Open the product to check the gallery, reference price and item number.
stepOpen: Open the same item on Hipobuy
stepOpenBody: Select Buy on Hipobuy. On the official product page, verify the item, size, color, quantity and the current price. Use Add to cart or Buy now when you have selected the correct options.
stepOrderBody: Sign in on Hipobuy. Review the product, selected options and domestic shipping to the warehouse. Review the amount due before confirming the order.
stepWarehouseBody: After the seller ships to the Hipobuy warehouse, open your stored item and review its inspection photos. If you see an issue, check the available after-sales options before shipping.
stepShip: Estimate shipping and submit the parcel
stepShipBody: Check the shipping estimate using the destination, weight and parcel dimensions. In your Hipobuy warehouse, choose the items, check the route and address, then review the final quote before paying.
faqIntro: Find answers about product links, reference prices, photo search and QC.
faq1Body: A searchable catalog of listings you can open on the Hipobuy buying agent. This preview uses the Findspreadsheet Weidian catalog.
faq2: Can I search by a Weidian item ID?
faq2Body: Yes. Enter the numeric item ID or paste a Weidian or Hipobuy item link in the search box.
faq3: Are the QC photos from my order?
faq3Body: Historical QC photos are examples from earlier warehouse checks. Review your own order photos in Hipobuy before arranging shipment.
faq4: Is the listed price the amount I will pay?
faq4Body: Prices are Findspreadsheet references in CNY. Check the current item price, agent charges and shipping on Hipobuy.
faq5Body: Choose a photo and the browser compares it with the saved Findspreadsheet image index. Similar colors and shapes can produce unrelated matches.
faq6: Where do I register or pay?
faq6Body: Registration, checkout, order storage and international shipping are handled at hipobuy.com.
seoLead: Find Weidian product links by keyword, item ID, category or image. Learn how to verify a listing and use warehouse QC photos.
seoFindsBody: Start with a category or search for a product name. If you already have a listing link, search by the exact item ID to find the matching entry.
seoQcBody: Open the same Weidian item ID to view available historical warehouse photos. Review your own warehouse photos once your order arrives.
seoOrderBody: Use the guide to compare variants, check the warehouse and estimate international shipping before committing to a route.

faqFindGroup: Spreadsheet, product links and image search
faq7: Does this Hipobuy spreadsheet include Taobao and 1688 links?
faq7Body: This catalog lists Weidian items. Hipobuy also supports Taobao and 1688. Paste those links into Hipobuy directly, then confirm the marketplace and item before ordering.
faq8: How do I compare sizes, variants and buying agents?
faq8Body: Open the exact item ID, read the seller’s measurement chart, and match the color, size and version. Use the shopping agent menu to open the same Weidian listing on a different agent. Compare the final quotes before paying.
faq9: What if the Hipobuy QC finder shows no photos?
faq9Body: Check that the item ID is correct. A listing may have no saved historical photos. Compare the seller gallery with the listed specs, then inspect your own warehouse photos before shipping.
faq10: What should I check in Hipobuy warehouse QC photos?
faq10Body: Match the visible color, version and quantity to your order. Compare labels, stitching and any photographed measurements with the seller listing. Ask Hipobuy about more photos or after-sales options if anything is unclear.
faq11: Can I request a return after warehouse inspection?
faq11Body: Open the item in your Hipobuy account and check the available return or exchange action. Eligibility, deadlines, and fees depend on the item and seller. Resolve issues before submitting the parcel.
faq12: How do I use the Hipobuy shipping calculator?
faq12Body: Open the official shipping estimator. Enter the destination and estimated packed weight and dimensions. Compare available routes, then verify the final price and restrictions when you submit your parcel.
faq13: What is the difference between actual and volumetric weight?
faq13Body: Actual weight is what the packed parcel weighs. Volumetric weight reflects the space it takes up. The route determines which calculation applies, so check the selected route with the final measurements.
faq14: What is paid at checkout and what is paid at shipment?
faq14Body: Confirm the item price, domestic shipping to the warehouse and any selected services when ordering. After warehouse inspection, review the international shipping quote and applicable charges separately when submitting the parcel.
faq15: Can I combine warehouse items and track one parcel?
faq15Body: Choose compatible stored items in your Hipobuy warehouse and review the address, packaging and shipping route before submitting. Open the parcel record for tracking when it has been dispatched.
faq16: Where do my saved items and currency settings go?
faq16Body: The browser remembers your preferences and saved products on this device. Converted prices are estimates. Check the live total with the selected agent before paying.
productIntroTitle: How to read a Hipobuy product page
productIntroLead: Use this real Findspreadsheet listing to see how the product gallery, Weidian item ID, reference price, buying options and warehouse QC fit together before you place an order.
productIntroGalleryBody: Start with the seller photos. Use the thumbnails to check the front, back, seams and printed details where available. Match the title and Weidian item ID to the agent’s page so you open the same listing.
productIntroVariantsBody: Open the live listing to check which sizes, colors and versions are available. Compare its measurement chart with a similar item you own. For a T-shirt, check whether the seller lists chest width or circumference, then compare body and sleeve length.
productIntroPriceBody: The catalog shows a reference price in the currency selected on the spreadsheet. Confirm the price of your selected variant, domestic delivery and any optional services when ordering. Review international shipping separately when the parcel is ready.
productIntroAgentBody: Use the primary buying button to open the item on your selected shopping agent. Other shopping agents opens the same Weidian item elsewhere. Confirm the item ID, selected options and payable total before checking out.
productIntroQcBody: Seller photos describe the listing. Historical QC photos show an earlier warehouse inspection when available. The example T-shirt has no saved warehouse photos, so use the separate QC example to see what they look like. Inspect your own order photos before shipping.
productIntroRelatedBody: Scroll below QC to compare related finds from the same category. If you only have a photo, use image search to find visual matches, then open and verify the exact listing and options. Similar images can refer to different products.
